units.source_text: 走到吉普车旁，美国兵让女人先上车，然后挂着一副威严的阵胜，冲着我说了声谢谢。

en.t: When we reached the jeep, the American soldier let the woman get in first, then, with an air of stern dignity, said thank you to me.

units.source_text: 他还要给我钱，我拒绝收下。

en.t: He also tried to give me money, but I refused to take it.

units.source_text: 他又从车座上取出了两条美国香烟，塞在我的手里。

en.t: Then he took two cartons of American cigarettes from the seat and pressed them into my hands.
